aliases: Off the job, on the job and on line training

one_line_answer.text: Choose the delivery mode that best suits the needs of your participants.

cites.quote: There are number of training delivery modes or approaches and you will need to decide which one/s best suit the needs of your participants.

bangla_explanation: Training কোথায় ও কীভাবে হবে, সেটাই delivery mode: off the job, on the job, বা on line।
Participants-দের needs, competencies, LL&N আর resources দেখে mode বেছে নিন।
On the job হলে real workplace situations আর peer support পাওয়া যায়।
On line mode-এ internet connection লাগে, আর technology issues সামলাতে হয়।

example.en: Garment trainees first learn in the institute (off the job). Later they practise on the factory floor (on the job).
example.bn: একই কোর্সে দুটো mode মিলিয়েও ব্যবহার করা যায়।

items.text: Off the job: participants are grouped and attend regularly.
On the job training at the work place.
On line: trainees use email and the Internet to access resources.

traps.text: Off the job: whole group needs to meet; course pace set by trainer.
On line mode requires internet connection and troubleshooting of technology issues.

cites.quote: • Requires internet connection and troubleshooting related to technology issues

short.prompt: What are the training delivery modes, and how do you choose one?
short.modelAnswer:
Training delivery modes:
1. Off the job: participants are grouped and attend regularly.
2. On the job training at the work place.
3. On line: trainees use email and the Internet.
Choose by the competencies, program goals, learner characteristics, LL&N requirements and available resources.

keyPoints.text: Base the choice on competencies, program goals, learner characteristics, LL&N, resources and equipment.

cites.quote: Your choice should be based on appropriateness to the competencies to be achieved, the goals of the training program, the characteristics of the learners, LL&N requirements, availability of resources and equipment.

keyPoints.text: Off the job provides interaction and social opportunities among participants.
On the job gives real workplace situations and peer support.
